text:
harry: quick FYI 1: we're scheduling a late-night maintenance window to apply a small runtime config tweak + rolling restarts for dedicated pools. target start: 23:45 UTC. low risk but want customer comms ready (statuspage, email, SMS blurb for high-touch customers). who can draft?
deploy-bot: schedule=2026-08-10T23:45:00Z; canary=10m; rollout=75m; rollback=on_error_rate>6%_for_5m; notify-channel=#support.
alexa_support: I can draft. Posting three artifacts: (A) 1-line statuspage, (B) brief email for impacted list, (C) SMS for high-touch customers.
alexa_support: STATUSPAGE (short): "Maintenance: rolling runtime update on Dedicated inference pools in select regions. You may experience short request interruptions while pools restart. No data loss. Window: 23:45 UTC 1:45 UTC."
ops_mira: Suggest we avoid exact minutes on statuspage; say "short interruptions" instead. Also include live update link in the email.
alexa_support: updated STATUSPAGE: "Maintenance: rolling runtime update on Dedicated inference pools in select regions. You may experience short interruptions while pools restart. No customer data will be affected. Window: 23:45 UTC 1:45 UTC."
ops_mira: EMAIL (impacted customers): "Subject: Notice: Redwood runtime maintenance tonight (23:45 UTC)\n\nHello,\n\nWe will apply a small runtime configuration update and perform rolling restarts of dedicated inference pools starting at 23:45 UTC. Impact: you may see brief request interruptions or retries while affected pools restart; most requests will be served from warm pools.\n\nIf your account is on our critical SLA list we will pin your workload to the current runtime snapshot for the duration. We will monitor metrics closely and automatically rollback if error rates exceed safety thresholds.\n\nLive updates will be posted to: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/12345\n\nNo action is required unless this conflicts with a strict production freeze. To request manual pinning or an alternate window reply to this message or contact support@redwood.com.\n\nThanks,\nRedwood Inference Operations"
ops_mira: SMS (high-touch): "Redwood: Brief maintenance starting 23:45 UTC. You may see short request interruptions. Reply 'PIN' to request manual pinning. Status: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/12345"
infra_ina: ops note: we'll pin ~20 customers automatically 15m before window; mira, I'll send the list to you by 18:00 UTC. Also enable verbose canary logs and keep verbose tracing for pinned routes.
harry: product wants a short line about quality checks in the email: "We will pause the rollout if we observe generation-quality regressions and notify impacted customers." add that to email.
product_sam: also request: include post-rollout artifacts in the email thread (token-level cost delta + small quality diff with 5 sample prompts).
alexa_support: added the quality hold line and post-rollout note.
ops_mira: PIN COMMAND (internal example):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/pins" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"cust-555","route":"/v1/complete","model":"rwd-13b-q","version":"2026-07-20"}'
```
ops_mira: I'll schedule the auto-pins at 23:30 UTC.
sales_raj: small ask: include an SMS fallback for customers without email (we just drafted it) and note timezone conversions in the email (APAC/Eastern).
alexa_support: I'll attach localized time table in the email footer. Quick table: 23:45 UTC = 00:45 BST, 04:45 SGT, 19:45 PDT.
harry: final: publish statuspage 30m prior, broadcast email at T+5 into canary, and only send SMS to the high-touch list 10m before start. After rollout export token-cost delta and a 5-prompt quality diff for product_sam. Keep edits in this thread only.
deploy-bot: update: schedule_confirmed=2026-08-10T23:45:00Z; statuspage-hook=queued; email-hook=queued; auto-announce-channel=#support.
alexa_support: queued the statuspage and email per timings. will post final templates to #ops-docs. :white_check_mark:
harry: thanks team. flag anything here if schedule changes.
